limitations: Observer attaches after HOME load, before local start; its module requests precede startAt.
terrain-complete follows the existing progress.complete callback; no readiness is advanced.
map-dom-ready and controls-available are DOM observations, not visible paint or proof of physical input.
Actual drag/zoom/visual checks are user observations; transform events are supplementary.
Native image diagnostics retain the original bounded last-12 records; Resource Timing covers requests, not independent decode CPU.
A new page is not proof of a completely cold cache; transferSize is a browser report.
No game state, cookies, authentication value, or full resource URL/query is exported.
